e.title: insurance-dro
e.summary: 分布鲁棒费率优化（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：Wasserstein/KL/chi2 模糊集、CVXPY 可解重构、稳健性代价前沿
e.summary_en: Distributionally robust rate optimisation (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.0): Wasserstein/KL/chi2 ambiguity sets, tractable CVXPY reformulations, price-of-robustness frontier
e.summary_hk: 分佈魯棒費率優化（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：Wasserstein/KL/chi2 模糊集、CVXPY 可解重構、穩健性代價前沿
e.body: insurance-dro（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做分布鲁棒（DRO）费率优化：Wasserstein/KL/chi2 模糊集、CVXPY+CLARABEL 可解重构、稳健性代价（price of robustness）前沿、FCA ENBP 场景——英国个人险定价。对 RIAA：费率优化对模型不确定性的稳健化——传统费率优化假设模型正确，DRO 显式考虑分布模糊（模型风险）；与 [[insurance-causal]]（因果推断定价）、[[insurance-fairness]]（公平性）同属定价的前沿约束方向；「稳健性代价前沿」回答「稳健定价多花多少钱」；burning-cost 家族第 24 个成员；适合定价研究方向的进阶工具。
e.body_en: insurance-dro (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) does distributionally robust (DRO) rate optimisation: Wasserstein/KL/chi2 ambiguity sets, tractable CVXPY+CLARABEL reformulations, price-of-robustness frontiers, FCA ENBP scenarios — UK personal lines pricing. For RIAA: making rate optimisation robust to model uncertainty — traditional rate optimisation assumes the model is correct, DRO explicitly accounts for distributional ambiguity (model risk); joins [[insurance-causal]] (causal pricing) and [[insurance-fairness]] (fairness) in the frontier of pricing constraints; the 'price of robustness' frontier answers 'how much does robust pricing cost'; the 24th member of the burning-cost family; an advanced tool for pricing research.
e.body_hk: insurance-dro（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做分佈魯棒（DRO）費率優化：Wasserstein/KL/chi2 模糊集、CVXPY+CLARABEL 可解重構、穩健性代價（price of robustness）前沿、FCA ENBP 場景——英國個人險定價。對 RIAA：費率優化對模型不確定性的穩健化——傳統費率優化假設模型正確，DRO 顯式考慮分佈模糊（模型風險）；與 [[insurance-causal]]（因果推斷定價）、[[insurance-fairness]]（公平性）同屬定價的前沿約束方向；「穩健性代價前沿」回答「穩健定價多花多少錢」；burning-cost 家族第 24 個成員；適合定價研究方向的進階工具。
